headline: Age 74: Former Qatar emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa dies
summary: The nation's top government body, the Amiri Diwan, announced the passing of the former ruler on Sunday.
details: Former Qatari Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani has passed away at the age of 74.
The announcement was made on Sunday by the Amiri Diwan, which serves as the nation's top government body.

headline: 44 dead as floods hit 7 districts due to heavy rain
summary: Severe flooding caused by torrential rain and hill torrents has devastated several districts, including Rangamati and Cox's Bazar.
details: Heavy rainfall and hill torrents have triggered severe flooding across seven districts of Bangladesh, resulting in the deaths of 44 people.
caption:
44 people have died as torrential rain and hill torrents trigger severe flooding across seven districts.

Heavy rainfall and hill torrents have triggered severe flooding across seven districts of Bangladesh, resulting in the deaths of 44 people.
